title: Tire Ticket Fitment, Total and Posting — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty
content:
## Fitment

A Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty tire ticket is written only for a line whose entry gate lists the vehicle's class. The vehicle's class must be one of the classes the tire line is sold for; the vehicle record is the authority for its class. A fitment outside the line's listed classes (for example a passenger line on a light truck) is not sold. The ticket may not carry more tires than the line's most tires per ticket.

## Ticket total

The clause as first issued read: the pre-tax ticket total is the tire count times the price per tire, plus the tire count times the line's mount-and-balance charge per tire, plus the tire count times the TPMS sensor service kit charge per tire when the vehicle's TPMS type is direct or otherwise the valve stem charge per tire, plus the tire count times the scrap tire handling fee per tire for the old tires taken off, less the line's set instant savings when the tire count is at least the line's tires-needed figure. **That clause, as an unqualified rule for every ticket, is no longer in force.** It now holds for every ticket other than a one-tire replacement ticket written against a treadwear adjustment credit and other than the ticket of an ordered set the store cancels because its hold period lapsed. A one-tire replacement ticket written against a treadwear adjustment credit carries the balance figured under that ticket's own rule — the tire line less the credit applied, plus the line's mounting charge, plus the scrap tire handling fee, plus every line its own terms add and less every relief they take off, each worked out on its own. The ticket of an ordered set the store cancels because its hold period lapsed carries the tire price paid alone.

**Ticket total in force, worked (hypothetical ticket, prices invented for illustration):** 4 tires at $100.00 on a line whose mount and balance is $20.00, valve stem $3.00, scrap fee $4.00 and set savings $40.00 for 4 tires, on a vehicle without direct TPMS: $400.00 plus $80.00 plus $12.00 plus $16.00, less $40.00, is $468.00 before tax.

## Tax and posting

Sales tax is calculated by the store's point-of-sale system as a separate tax line and is never part of a charter computation. A ticket paid with the Crestline credit card posts to the card account and a ticket charged to a fleet account posts as a fleet invoice; cash, debit and bank-card tickets post nowhere else.
